purpose: Independent Hero pose studies for the paper forest; source paintings unchanged

poses.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one isolated full-body Hero painting for a forest pop-up book. Image 1 is the direct PAINTING STYLE reference: use its light translucent watercolor, softly merging washes, irregular pooling, broken brush edges, broad varied paint masses and a few loose gouache accents; no digital airbrush or repetitive sharp fur tiles. Image 2 is Hero IDENTITY only; its rendering style must not override image 1. Preserve this small female tricolor corgi-like dog: very large upright ears, compact long low body and short legs, rich charcoal/slate back, warm copper-golden-orange cheeks and legs, opaque creamy white forehead blaze/muzzle/chest/paw tips, amber eyes and gentle inquisitive tan brows. Short natural bobtail, no baked flame or elemental effect. Make the face softly painted with readable restrained features. True transparent background with clean alpha and opaque pale fur; no scene, ground, cast shadow, book, letters, labels, frame, paper rectangle or watermark. Complete ears, paws and tail fully inside the image with generous transparent margin. View at slightly elevated eye level in three-quarter view, suitable as a standing painted paper cutout. Pose: seated on her hindquarters, both front paws naturally planted, body turned slightly toward the viewer's right; head tilted upward and ears pricked with quiet wonder, mouth slightly open as if watching magical sparkles above the book. Do not paint the sparkles.
